decks.notes: This Azorius Aggro deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence with low-cost creatures and token generation, utilizing cards like Wedding Announcement and Resolute Reinforcements. With strong support from Make Disappear for control and Zephyr Sentinel for flying evasion, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent early in the game. In addition, the inclusion of cards like Recruitment Officer and Harbin, Vanguard Aviator help maintain card advantage and provide additional strategic options. The deck also benefits from a well-balanced mana base to ensure smooth gameplay.

This Bant Control deck focuses on countering opponent's spells, disrupting their strategy, and controlling the battlefield through card advantage. It includes a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures to establish dominance. The deck aims to control the pace of the game, outvalue opponents, and ultimately secure the win through careful resource management and strategic plays. With a mix of creature threats, disruption, and card draw, this deck is designed to adapt to different matchups and come out on top through careful planning and precise execution.

This deck focuses on establishing control through powerful enchantments like Leyline Binding and Archangel of Wrath, supported by creatures like Atraxa and Topiary Stomper to maintain board presence. The strategy involves ramping up mana with cards like Spara's Headquarters and Jetmir's Garden to cast big threats like Sunfall and Boseiju, Who Endures. The deck also includes removal and card draw in the form of Go for the Throat and Courier's Briefcase. Overall, the goal of the deck is to outvalue the opponent and control the game until victory is assured.

This Bant Control deck focuses on using a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and powerful creatures to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck includes a mix of counterspells like Negate and Syncopate, removal spells like Make Disappear and Lay Down Arms, and powerful finishers like The Wandering Emperor and Horned Loch-Whale. With a strong mana base and a variety of spells to control the board, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and ultimately win through superior card advantage and powerful threats.

This deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells. Using a mix of powerful creatures like Dennick, Pious Apprentice and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, along with disruptive spells like Make Disappear and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to control the board and pressure the opponent. The addition of Wedding Announcement and Virtue of Loyalty provides the deck with additional support and synergy, while cards like Raffine, Scheming Seer and The Wandering Emperor offer card advantage and flexibility. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive playstyle of the deck.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures early on while disrupting the opponent with hand disruption spells like Duress and removal spells like Go for the Throat. It also includes powerful Planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil to control the board. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures like Glissa Sunslayer and Mosswood Dreadknight, while also utilizing graveyard recursion and protection with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Virtue of Persistence. The deck has a mix of powerful creatures, removal, and disruptive spells to maintain board control and pressure the opponent.

The main idea of this deck is to maintain control over the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures. With cards like Memory Deluge, Dissipate, and Syncopate, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while advancing its own game plan. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Lay Down Arms helps to further solidify its control over the battlefield. The deck also features a mix of land cards to ensure consistent access to its mana base, allowing for optimal performance in a Standard 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on filling the board quickly with creatures that provide beneficial effects and using spells to support them. By utilizing cards like Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr and Generous Visitor, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a swarm of powerful creatures. The inclusion of cards like Teachings of the Kirin and Commune with Spirits allows for card draw and consistency in playing multiple threats each turn. Additionally, the deck utilizes lands like Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect key cards and spells from removal.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of control elements, powerful creatures, and enchantments to dominate the battlefield. It aims to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Herd Migration and Archangel of Wrath, while using Leyline Binding and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to control the opponent's board. The deck also includes removal spells like Go for the Throat and powerful finishers like Sunfall and Invasion of Zendikar. By utilizing a mix of creature aggression and control elements, this deck aims to outlast and overpower opponents in a 1 vs 1 matchup.

This deck focuses on using a mix of control spells and creatures to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key strategy is to efficiently ramp up mana through cards like Jetmir's Garden and Spara's Headquarters, while utilizing creatures like Archangel of Wrath and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to control the battlefield. Leyline Binding and Virtue of Persistence help to stabilize the board, while Topiary Stomper and Sunfall provide additional threats. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and secure victory through a combination of card advantage and efficient creature plays.

The deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with low-cost, aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar provide a strong presence while cards like Hopeful Initiate and Coppercoat Vanguard offer additional threats. The inclusion of cards like Virtue of Loyalty and Ossification help to buff and protect the board, while Recruitment Officer allows for constant replenishment of creatures. Overall, the strategy revolves around maintaining a fast-paced, aggressive approach to apply constant pressure on the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize various control spells and abilities to maintain board presence and prevent opponent's strategies. By combining cards like Go for the Throat, Archangel of Wrath, and Leyline Binding with powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Mirrex, the deck aims to control the game tempo and outlast opponents. The inclusion of cards like Courier's Briefcase and Virtue of Persistence provide card advantage and additional resource management. Overall, this deck seeks to overpower opponents through efficient control and strong creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost, high-damage creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. By playing aggressive creatures like Bloodthirsty Adversary and Monastery Swiftspear alongside burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire, the deck aims to maintain pressure early on. The inclusion of cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance allows for additional damage output and removal options. The deck also includes recursion with Squee, Dubious Monarch and Feldon, Ronom Excavator to ensure continuous threats on the battlefield.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent's life total using cheap and efficient red spells and creatures. The deck focuses on dealing direct damage with cards like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire, while also utilizing creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Bloodthirsty Adversary to apply pressure early in the game. The deck includes some utility cards like Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance and Mishra's Foundry to support its aggressive strategy. Additionally, the deck includes a few late-game threats like Feldon, Ronom Excavator and Nahiri's Warcrafting to ensure it has options in longer games.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of creature removal, land manipulation, and powerful finishers. By utilizing Leyline Binding and Herd Migration to establish board presence, followed by Virtue of Persistence and Bramble Familiar for resilience, the deck aims to outlast opponents while setting up for impactful plays with Etali, Primal Conqueror and Invasion of Alara. The inclusion of versatile creatures like Greater Tanuki and Mirrorshell Crab provides additional utility, while interaction spells like Go for the Throat help maintain control over the battlefield.

This deck focuses on establishing control over the game by utilizing a combination of powerful creatures, spells, and enchantments to dominate the battlefield. It relies on generating card advantage and board presence through cards like Topiary Stomper and Archangel of Wrath, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with Leyline Binding and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. By utilizing a mix of removal spells and ramp cards like Herd Migration and Up the Beanstalk, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent, ultimately leading to victory through overwhelming board presence and resource management.
